title: Wilbert Smith's secret role running radio monitoring in Ottawa

tellings.quote: He said, "He had a super top security clearance. He ran radio Ottawa."

plain: In the 1950s, a Canadian official named Wilbert B. Smith is said to have held a top secret clearance and run radio monitoring in Ottawa, Canada's capital. Grant Cameron, a guest on the show, passes this on from a man named Art Bridge, who told him that Smith "had a super top security clearance" and "ran radio Ottawa." The point of telling it is that Smith would have been a well-placed government insider, not an outsider.
